answer: The ferrous counter is kept in ridge and basalt makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An hostile operator hence has to keep each alias continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 7 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
